info.title: DocTayo API
info.description: Clinic management backend. Errors use { error: { status, code, message, details?, requestId } }.

key.description: Stable machine key; use it in code, not the name.

accessToken.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Keep it in memory, not in storage.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

activeTenantId.description: Chosen automatically when the user has exactly one active membership in an active clinic; otherwise null and the client calls switch-tenant.

permissions.description: Effective permission keys in that clinic.

token.description: The token from the emailed link.
The token from the emailed link.

The token from the emailed link.

version.description: Send it back when editing or archiving (optimistic locking).

birthDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, a real date from 1900 to tomorrow (UTC). Never a time.

phone.description: Local formats are accepted and stored as E.164 (+639171234567).

notes.description: Non-clinical notes for the front desk, e.g. "prefers Tagalog".

version.description: The version you read. A stale one is 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.

reason.description: Why the patient is archived. Shown to staff, not to the patient.

membershipId.description: An active member of this clinic (`GET /directory`).

startsAt.description: HH:mm, wall clock of the branch's time zone.

isActive.description: `false` hides them from booking; nothing is deleted.

blocks.description: The whole week; it replaces the previous one. Blocks of the same weekday must not overlap, whatever the branch. An empty list clears the week.

isActive.description: Offer only active practitioners for booking.

price.description: Always two decimals; `null`: no fixed price.

name.description: Unique in the clinic, ignoring case.

price.description: PHP as a decimal string with up to two decimals. `null`: no fixed price (not the same as free, `"0"`).
PHP as a decimal string with up to two decimals. `null`: no fixed price (not the same as free, `"0"`).

isActive.description: `false` hides it from pickers; nothing is deleted.

version.description: Send it back with every change (optimistic locking).

kind.description: `walk_in`: the patient is here now. It is created checked in, starts now, ends at an estimate and never blocks a slot.

practitionerMembershipId.description: A member with an active practitioner profile (`GET /directory?practitionersOnly=true`).

startsAt.description: Required for `scheduled`, refused for `walk_in`. ISO 8601 with `Z` or an offset, to the whole minute, e.g. `2026-12-07T09:00:00+08:00`.

endsAt.description: Required for `scheduled`, refused for `walk_in`. At most 8 hours after the start. ISO 8601 with `Z` or an offset, to the whole minute, e.g. `2026-12-07T09:00:00+08:00`.

reason.description: The purpose of the visit, never symptoms: every role can read it.

platformRole.description: `platform_admin` may use `/admin/*` (show the Clinics and Users tabs). It grants no access to any clinic.

permissions.description: Effective permissions in the active clinic (empty when none is selected or the membership is not active). Use them to build menus; the server enforces them regardless.

practitionerProfileId.description: Your own practitioner profile in the active clinic ("my schedule"); null without an active clinic or an active profile.

current.description: True for the session making this request.

roleIds.description: Replaces the member’s roles. Ids from `GET /roles`; `owner` only for owners.

roleId.description: A role of this clinic (not owner).

assignable.description: Whether the caller may give this role through `PATCH /members/:id` (owner: owners only).

slug.description: Lower-case letters and digits separated by single hyphens.

message.description: Static, user-safe text; never echoes input.

requestId.description: Also the X-Request-Id response header; quote it to support.
